quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on the Raptors' loss to the Milwaukee Bucks
quotes.excerpt: I think it's a big shout out to the Bucks, they played good basketball.
quotes.quote: I think it's a big shout out to the Bucks, they played good basketball. I can't take nothing away from them. I think we could have done a lot of things better tonight, but we got to move on. We got to be better.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead

quotes.excerpt: I think we started off the season winning games like this by 20 or more.
quotes.quote: No, I don't think it's a common theme. I think we started off the season winning games like this by 20 or more. We have it in us and I can't give you an answer for tonight, but we just have to be better.

quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on the pressure to win games early in the season

quotes.quote: I mean, there's always pressure. I mean, we want to win games. This isn't a good showing and I think the pressure's been on since the season started, so I think we just got to find a way to win games. We keep saying the same thing over and over, we have to be better.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on the team's need to approach every game with the same intensity
quotes.excerpt: I think we have to grow up in that sense, just being prepared and being ready to approach every game differently.
quotes.quote: Approach this game the same way we approached Detroit. Approach every game the same way we approached Detroit. I think we have to grow up in that sense, just being prepared and being ready to approach every game differently and not feed off of what we've been doing, whether it's a high or a low. Just be even keel and come into every game ready to play.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Shead on the Raptors needing more maturity: We have to grow up in that sense, just being prepared and being ready to approach every game differently.

structured.context: Jamal Shead emphasizes the need for the team to maintain consistent intensity and preparation across every game.

quotes.quote: I think last year's over. I think all this year, we've kind of referenced last year a lot and we need to stop doing that. I think this year is this whole new puzzle and like I said, we got to figure it out. Like we just have to be better in a lot of assets and a lot of areas, we have to be better.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Shead says the Raptors need to stop looking back: I think last year is over. All this year we have kind of referenced last year a lot and we need to stop doing that.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on the difference between starting and coming off the bench
quotes.excerpt: Scotty was amazing tonight. You know, I think that kind of opened up a lot of our games.
quotes.quote: I wouldn't say challenges. I mean, you just certain guys, there's a pecking order. I mean, Scotty was amazing tonight. You know, I think that kind of opened up a lot of our games. We missed a lot of open shots because they were doubling him. I think if we make those shots, it's a different game. So, just playing off of different players and understanding your role when certain guys are back. So it's not just it's nothing different, it's just understanding how to play with certain guys, like playing the game with Scotty and playing the game with Quickley and just having those guys out there and knowing your role with those guys.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Shead on playing alongside Scottie Barnes: Scottie was amazing tonight. We missed a lot of open shots because they were doubling him. If we make those shots, it is a different game.

structured.context: Jamal Shead discusses the adjustments required when playing alongside teammates like Scottie Barnes and Immanuel Quickley.
